content: Hello! how can I help today?
I sold a property and agreed to be paid over 5 years. Do I have to use installment reporting?
No. You may **elect out of the installment method** under **IRC §453(d)** and recognize the full gain upfront, even if you receive payments over time.

Electing out may be beneficial if:
- You expect rising tax rates
- You have offsetting capital losses
- You want to avoid interest imputation rules
How do I make the election?
Report the full sale on **Form 8949 and Schedule D** in the year of sale. Do **not** file Form 6252. Attach a statement that you’re electing out under §453(d).
Can I reverse the election later?
No—once made, the election is **irrevocable**. Make sure you’ve assessed your cash flow and gain before proceeding.
